entries.text: The Snowflake adapter now requests the bundled SQLGlot runtime's opt-in `safe_division` rewrite through `apply_rewrite` before executing a query. A zero divisor still yields NULL (`a / NULLIF(b, 0)`); a divisor already written as `NULLIF(x, 0)` is no longer wrapped a second time. Queries without a division are regenerated from the parsed tree, so their text can differ in formatting but not in meaning. No published Snowflake result changes.
